units: studs (1 stud = 1 Blender unit, FBX exported 1:1)
frame: Roblox frame: +Y up, FRONT (cave mouth, stair flight, pool) = +Z (south), west flank (waterfall + pool) = -X. Origin = footprint centre at the base (y=0 is the rock base). Place all six FBXs at the same origin with identity rotation (yaw 0).

world_placement.source: placements.json cave footprint (centre 563.5, 66, -606.5; 240 x 140; front faces +Z)
world_placement.note: base y=0 maps to world y=66. The sheet terrain under it is not flat (see terrain_notes); sink/bury the base into the hill as needed.

size.target: about 240 x 150 x 140 (placements footprint x +-120, z +-70, height 150)
size.note: rock mass (lower+upper) stays inside x +-117, z +-70, y -0.5..149.4; foliage tops 142; stairs front edge z=70

mouth.was: 40 wide x 36 tall in v1 (1.5x now)
mouth.note: mouth centre x local +20 = world 583.5 (placements centreX), floor y local 28 = world 94. Tunnel is a 64-stud-deep dead end (back wall z=-30); the warm glow is only at the back (z -29.7..-17), 55+ studs behind the mouth, as staggered light cards + a dim backdrop, not a slab over the mouth.

glow.kind: light cards (0.5 thick, one per 0.65 step in z from -28.3 to -23.1, never overlapping in x), 2 dim backdrop panels at z -29.55/-29.05, floor glow patches, 2 hanging globes at z -8
glow.v2_1_change: glow part only: lighter, more saturated orange palette (linear luminance ratio new/v2 in linear_luminance_old_new_ratio; about 1.2-1.4x; a full 2x is not reachable with a saturated orange in sRGB because red is already at 255, so the rest has to come from Neon material / PointLight in Studio); cards re-laid so no two glow boxes touch or intersect (min facing gap 0.1 studs, 0.15 above the floor, 0.1 off the back wall); the floor patch no longer pierces the cards. No lights added: RobloxDevBot adds the PointLight in Studio.
glow.z_fight_check: pairwise box check of all 15 glow boxes: 0 intersections, min facing gap 0.1 studs
glow.preview_note: With Workbench shadows on, tunnel_depth still shows pale patches on the cards: these are sunlight through the arch (shadow-map lit regions), not geometry; previews_cave_v2_1/tunnel_depth_noshadow_diag.png (shadows off) shows clean flat cards.

waterfall.colour: WhiteWater (240,250,252) centre 52% of width, WaterLt (170,224,236) edges, foam streaks and base splash

pool.note: pool is inside the footprint, in front of the west flank, directly at the base of the waterfall (placements pool centre was 34 studs outside the face; adjust the course water if needed)

stairs.note: decorative stair flight 40 wide (v1 30); mouth floor y local 28 = world 94

colour.rule: top faces whose normal is within ~57 deg of the sun (-0.45,0.75,0.50 normalised: from the west-south-west, front) are Sandy (190,150,110) / SandyDk (171,133,98); the rest of the tops are slate-light / moss. Sides: lit side faces RockLt, shaded RockDk, base Rock (95,85,105).

silhouette.skyline: climbs west -> east: west shoulder ~100, east summit ~146 (max 149.4 incl. slab tilt); saddle at x~10
silhouette.slabs: ~257 chunky leaning slabs (9-12 x 6.5-8.8 studs), stacked in 2-4 segments with setbacks, tops tilted, lean up to 8-15 studs; no repeated hex columns; ~60 small ceiling columns only above the tunnel

pad_clearance.rule: art-clear 54x84 rectangles vs the mesh x/z bounding footprint (studs); footprint front edge world z -536.5, x 446.5..681.7

not_a_gameplay_surface: Scenery only. No flat ledges, no pads, no putting surface, nothing meant to be walked on; every part should be CanCollide=false except optionally an invisible blocker the course builder adds. Stairs and tunnel are decorative.

cave_cliff_lower.kind: lower rock mass (y 0..64): chunky leaning rock slabs, foot boulders, tunnel floor/jambs/back wall, arch jambs

cave_cliff_upper.kind: upper rock tiers (y 44..149) incl. the east summit; arch voussoirs + lintel over the mouth; waterfall backing wall

cave_stairs.kind: stone stair flight from the mouth floor (y 28) down to the front (z +70), rails + torches

cave_water.kind: wide white west-flank waterfall sheet (22 studs, white core) + foam + pool surface (swap to semi-transparent SmoothPlastic / Neon-ish white in Studio)

cave_glow.kind: warm orange light cards + dim backdrop panels + floor glow set 55-64 studs deep at the back of the tunnel, plus the 6 stair lantern globes (swap to Neon; the PointLight is added in Studio)

cave_foliage.kind: palms, vines, moss/bushes (separate so Studio can set Plastic / transparency / CanCollide=false)

terrain_notes: Heightmap terrain under the footprint is lower than y=66 at the back and flanks (base floats up to ~60 studs above ground there) and about 96-108 at the mouth/stairs (above the mouth floor y=94). Fix by sinking/burying the base or filling terrain; the mesh cannot adapt.
deviations: No pad ledges in the mesh (pads are never in art meshes).
Pool is a tub inside the footprint at local (-80,48.4,36), not 34 studs outside the face.
Stair rise is 18 studs (y 10 -> 28) at the front, not a full ground-to-mouth ramp.
Mouth ceiling is built from ~60 small hanging columns (arch roof is stepped, not a smooth vault).
The back (north) side is plain slabs with a few dark flat gaps; it faces away from every pad.
Foliage extends to x -115.5..118.2 and z 68.3; rock mass x -117..115, z -68.4..69.6; stairs to z 70.
note_v2_1: FBXs of the five unchanged parts are byte copies of cave_v2 (geometry json identical); only cave_glow.fbx was rebuilt. Rock colour intentionally unchanged (waits for a Studio screenshot). Previews here are only 3q, mouth_closeup, tunnel_depth; use cave_v2/previews_cave_v2 for the other views (unchanged geometry).
